atoms.text:
Sally wiggled her nose and whiskers as she observed the painting. Her long velvety ears twitched in annoyance.

“I don’t know, Otto, I think there is something missing,” she said to her friend, feeling frustrated.

Otto stood up from the sofa and trotted to where Sally observed her work. He took the painting in with his fox eyes.

instruction.text: Drag the words to the correct definitions.

atoms.text:
“Well,” said Otto carefully, “I would say it is missing something. My tail!”

“Oh yes, of course! How could I forget your tail! Sit down again, please! I am going to paint your tail!”

Otto sat back down, made sure his red, fluffy tail was clearly positioned and smiled for the artist.

Otto liked modelling for Sally, she always made him look his best. Although she could be forgetful, she was the best painter in town!
